commits.message:
xo login, one address for every command, and the server passes creates on to XO (#10)

* Add xo login and xo logout

xo login asks for the API key without echo, checks it with the xo server's
/me, and saves it to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/xo/credentials (~/.config/xo/credentials)
with the folder 0700 and the file 0600, written whole and renamed into place.
A key that fails the check is not saved; --no-check saves without checking.
Later commands use --api-key, then XO_API_KEY, then the saved key. A saved
file other users could read, or a symlink, is refused. xo logout deletes it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01SBUmhUH6RQViYBmTp6swFy

* One address for every command; the server passes creates on to XO

Every command now goes to one address: XO_URL, --url, or the one
xo login saved, else https://xo.quirq.dev. XO_BASE_URL, XO_SERVER_URL,
--base-url and --server-url are gone. The xo server passes the creates
and space reads on to XO's core API under its /api/core/v1, allow-listed
by method and path, with only the bearer key and a few headers, no
redirects, a 25 s timeout and a per-key limit.

xo login prints the address before it reads the key, refuses anything
but an ak_ key, checks the key with XO (a space that does not exist
must answer XO's own 404), and saves the key with that address. The
saved key is only sent to the address it was saved with. The saved
file must be a regular file owned by you that no one else can read.

commits.message:
xo projects: a projects list in private metadata, written only by the server (#28)

* xo projects: a projects list in private metadata, written only by the server

GET /me/projects shows the key's own private metadata `projects`; POST
/me/projects {"name": ...} adds one. The client sends only the name. The
server validates it, reads the list, appends, and sends Clerk a metadata
merge naming only `projects`, so no other key changes. Adds are
serialized per user per instance, the written list is read back and the
add retried if another write replaced it; a non-list `projects`, a
duplicate or a full list is refused without a write. Audited without
names. `xo projects` and `xo projects add NAME` call it.

* xo create, connect and list: projects and spaces recorded by the server

xo create project NAME|URL adds the project and makes its folder (a GitHub
owner/repo is cloned, any other name gets git init). xo create space KIND NAME
creates the space through XO as xo KIND does and the server records it in the
caller's own private metadata spaces list. xo connect sets a project's ref in a
space, or records a space the key can read. xo list shows projects or spaces.

The server builds every change and writes only the one list, with the same
settle, re-read and put-back as xo projects; other spaces are put back at their
highest rev, and a space changed meanwhile is a 409. Writes stop at 6KB of
private metadata. Names and refs are checked on both sides, and git runs with
plain https only, no submodules, --end-of-options and no xo tokens.

commits.message:
xo install, update and sync for projects and spaces (#32)

* xo install, update and sync for projects and spaces

xo install space:S clones or fetches each GitHub project of a space into
./S/OWNER/REPO at its ref and remembers the rev; xo update records the refs
checked out there with PUT /me/spaces/S, refused unless the space's rev is still
the one installed; xo sync merges the space's changes with yours and stops on a
project both changed. For a project, update is git push and sync is pull
--rebase then push: never forced, current branch to its upstream only, refused
on a dirty tree or detached HEAD. Names and refs from metadata are checked again
before git sees them, and a ref its remote lacks is never recorded.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01SBUmhUH6RQViYBmTp6swFy

* xo install/update/sync: own checkouts only, race-safe records, push per project

- git refuses a folder that is not a checkout of its own, so xo never
  fetches or pushes an enclosing repository
- PUT /me/spaces/{name} also takes base, the projects the change starts
  from, and refuses unless the space still holds them; nothing changed
  means no new rev; a space named connect can be updated
- sync keeps your refs when the space's rev went back, saves the state
  right after moving checkouts, and stops when the space dropped a
  project you changed
- update space pushes each branch first and records nothing when refs are
  unchanged; sync space rebases each branch on its upstream and pushes it
- install project fast-forwards an existing checkout
- a conflicting rebase is undone and said so; clearer git errors
- a JSON number too long to read is a 422, not a 500
- tests run xo's own git without user or system config

commits.message:
xo share, accept and reject: invites in the recipient's shared list (#34)

* xo share, accept and reject: invites in the recipient's shared list

xo share space:S|project:OWNER/REPO USERNAME puts an invite in that user's
private metadata, in a new shared list: the space's name and projects, never
its id. The recipient runs xo list shared, then xo accept (a copy goes into
their own spaces and projects) or xo reject (it comes off the list).

The server writes only the recipient's shared key, only the sharer's own
invite, with the usual lock, settle, re-read and 6KB check. Everything about
the recipient is the same 404, every share takes 1.5s at least, and the limits
are 20 invites waiting, 5 per sender and 10 shares a minute.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01SBUmhUH6RQViYBmTp6swFy

* xo share: own room for invites, one-write accept by id, 7-day block

- invites never stop a user's own writes: shared has its own 1.5KB (1KB an
  invite), and own writes do not count it
- accept checks every refusal first, then writes spaces, projects and shared
  in one Clerk merge; a refused accept leaves nothing behind
- accept and reject take the id xo list shared shows (a hash of the sender id
  and the exact invite); the list shows each sender's username now; xo accept
  shows what it adds and asks y/N (--yes)
- reject blocks that sender and item for 7 days
- an identical re-share writes nothing; a changed one waits a minute
- a space invite leaves local projects out
- the 1.5s floor starts once the key is verified
- docs: who can write what, rate limits, audit values, Clerk calls per share
